QuestInfo.name: [Twilight Perion] The Dream Gatherer
QuestInfo.0: The nightmare is still causing problems. Some have grown addicted to the dream world, and become unable to distinguish it from reality. Is there a way to cure them? Ask #bGrendel the Really Old#k.
QuestInfo.1: Grendel told you Lucid Matter can cure the dream addiction. Defeat the monsters in Twilight Perion and collect #b8 pieces of Lucid Matter#k.
QuestInfo.2: You brought the Lucid Matter to Grendel. In theory, it can cure the dreamers' addiction, but it won't completely break their connection to the nightmare.

1.0: Did you collect all 8 pieces of Lucid Matter?

yes.0: Thank you. These should cure the dream addiction.
yes.1: But this is a temporary measure, as it doesn't completely sever the connection to the nightmare. We need to find another way... Even I'm not sure what the next move is.
yes.2: There might be a way to break the nightmare entirely, if you knew more about who created it. Unfortunately, all you know so far is that they're not a Commander or a member of the Black Wings.
yes.3: Who controls the dream world? Who has the power to influence people's subconscious... Ah, #bsubconscious#k. That might be the key.

item.0: Collect #bLucid Matter#k in Twilight Perion. Around #b8 pieces#k will do.
